title: Parallel investigations
summary: Delegate independent work when it improves speed or evidence quality.

sections.label: Example split
sections.text: One investigator traces React behavior while another checks SPARQL fixtures. They return structured findings with versions and source locations.

sections.label: Merge discipline
sections.text: One owner combines findings, resolves contradictions, and controls the implementation. Avoid concurrent independent edits of the same files.

sections.label: Cost discipline
sections.text: Add an agent for a separable task or justified review perspective. Agent count and model agreement are not quality metrics.

catalog.applicability: Use when independent investigations can run at the same time and that improves speed or evidence quality. One owner merges the findings and controls the implementation, and concurrent edits of the same files are avoided.
catalog.limits: Reading a topic does not configure tools, execute a workflow or establish passing evidence.
